root_cause: Historically, the serializer combined a high number of independent validation, redaction, metadata-presence, formatting, and truncation branches in one function. PR #174 lowered the measured complexity from 32 to 26 but left the remaining control flow one point above the configured threshold. This record does not infer that PR #174 introduced the issue; it records the independently remediable historical current-master residual at the modified source boundary.
root_cause_de: Historisch kombinierte der Serializer viele unabhängige Validierungs-, Redaktions-, Metadatenpräsenz-, Formatierungs- und Trunkierungszweige in einer Funktion.
